description: Consumer wallet views as the Rust wallet contract resolves them with plain blocks (hero, stats, section, rows, qr); display values are fixtures, never calculated by the UI. Rewritten from wallet-flow-account-vectors.json (the retired account renderer's samples); the information test checks that no field was lost.
